rules: If rd is x0, the CSRRWI instruction does not read the CSR and does not cause any side effects that might occur on a CSR read.
If rd is not x0, the CSRRWI instruction reads the CSR and writes the CSR.
If uimm is zero, the CSRRWI instruction does not write to the CSR and does not cause any side effects that might otherwise occur on a CSR write.
If uimm is non-zero, the CSRRWI instruction reads the CSR and writes the CSR.
